mechanism_inventory: access-control mismatch — onlyFungible restricts both functions to FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS (hardcoded constant)
missing invariant enforcement (zero-address/sanity) — updateSystemContractAddress accepts any addr incl address(0); updateGasLimit accepts any uint256 incl 0
value exceeds bound — GAS_LIMIT arbitrarily large -> gasFee overflow/unbounded, bricks withdraw
wrong lifecycle ordering — SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS trusted by deposit(); pointing to attacker enables unauthorized mint
stale accounting — deposit grants mint rights to SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS; setting to attacker enables mint
external-call/DoS — malicious SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS reverts ISystem calls in withdrawGasFee, DoSing withdraw
victim accounting direction — attacker SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS mints arbitrary tokens

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: updateSystemContractAddress accepts any address (incl address(0)) without validation; deposit() grants minting rights to SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS with no further auth. If the fungible module sets SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS to a malicious address, an unauthorized party mints tokens (or the deposit flow breaks).
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Requires FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS to set SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS to a malicious address (privileged precondition); once triggered, impact is arbitrary minting.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. fungible module updateSystemContractAddress(attackerContract). 2. attacker deposit(victim,large) — passes msg.sender==SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS. 3. _mint inflates supply. 4. attacker deposit(attacker,large) for unlimited tokens.
selected_mechanisms.who_gains: Attacker controlling new SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS mints unlimited.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Direct path from updateSystemContractAddress to unauthorized mint via deposit(); missing zero/trusted-address validation; catastrophic on any module compromise/misconfig (design-level HIGH).

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: withdrawGasFee() calls ISystem(SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS).gasCoinZRC20ByChainId/gasPriceByChainId with no try/catch; a SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS set to a reverting contract permanently DoSes all withdraw().
selected_mechanisms.attacker_model: Requires fungible module to set SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS to a DoS contract; once set, DoS is permanent.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. updateSystemContractAddress(revertingContract). 2. withdraw() -> withdrawGasFee() -> ISystem reverts. 3. All withdrawals blocked.
selected_mechanisms.who_loses: All ZRC20 holders — funds locked, cannot withdraw.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Distinct from minting: different impact (fund lock/DoS), different victim outcome. Medium+ under severity floor.

selected_mechanisms.root_cause: updateGasLimit accepts any uint256 incl extremely large; gasFee=gasPrice*GAS_LIMIT+PROTOCOL_FLAT_FEE overflows (reverts) or becomes unaffordable, DoSing withdraw for all.
selected_mechanisms.exploit_path: 1. updateGasLimit(type(uint256).max). 2. withdraw() -> withdrawGasFee computes huge/overflowing fee -> revert/unaffordable. 3. withdrawals DoSed.
selected_mechanisms.why_carried: Distinct variable (GAS_LIMIT), distinct DoS vector; missing upper-bound guard. Medium+.

unresolved_mechanisms.mechanism: Whether FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS can be reached via forged cross-chain message (escalates privilege to unprivileged)
unresolved_mechanisms.source_evidence: FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS hardcoded constant; onlyFungible checks msg.sender==it; no cross-chain handling in this file; Interfaces.sol not included.
unresolved_mechanisms.unresolved_question: Is there a CCTX/observer path by which an external party causes FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS to invoke updateSystemContractAddress/updateGasLimit? If forgeable, severity -> CRITICAL.
unresolved_mechanisms.who_loses: All ZRC20 holders if privilege assumption violated.

rejected_mechanisms.rejecting_source_fact: modifier reverts CallerIsNotFungibleModule; FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS is a hardcoded constant, unchangeable.
rejected_mechanisms.why_unexploitable: Unprivileged EOA cannot pass msg.sender==FUNGIBLE_MODULE_ADDRESS (protocol precompile address).

impact_direction.attacker_receives: Unlimited ZRC20 if SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS redirected to attacker (deposit mint path).
impact_direction.victim_loses: All ZRC20 holders lose token value (inflation) or withdrawal access (DoS).
impact_direction.invariant_violated: SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS must be trusted ISystem; deposit extends mint trust without extra auth; GAS_LIMIT must be bounded. Neither enforced in update functions.
impact_direction.not_self_funded_or_dust_or_admin_or_timi: Impact on all holders (third-party victims); DoS locks real value; minting unbounded; privileged precondition noted but doesn't reduce victim impact once triggered.

stop_condition: more_mechanisms_pending: unauthorized mint via SYSTEM_CONTRACT_ADDRESS redirect, DoS via malicious ISystem, economic DoS via unbounded GAS_LIMIT carried; cross-chain forgery escalation unresolved
